title: Linked markup descriptors, native factory bodies and a resolved setter replay experiment
runtime_scope: 169 source documents; full editable WinUI, opaque external archives, structural interpreter fallback, unwind enabled. Source matches the ordinary Fat and profiled z runs.
interpretation: Markup records are discovered by the named 352-byte ::MARKUP statics and dereferenced using actual target rustc field offsets. Header and member array bytes count live static ranges. Empty slices are included in headers. The eight member arrays exclude registered-property attributes, enum/type strings, parameter type arrays, generic descriptions and other indirect storage.

A code target shared across multiple member slots is counted once in each indicated class and once in the union. Direct invoker bytes also have other callers and can include inlined member bodies. Value-type/typed-binding callbacks and static metadata are counted separately. These are reachability observations rather than bytes that every possible refactoring will remove.

Generated factory classes are based on the actual emitted function source. Each distinct address among native functions in the compiled_xaml namespace is counted once. A folded address may also have aliases in other namespaces, so this census can differ from whole-executable exclusive categories. Do not add it to totals from the whole-program attribution report.

setter_program_experiment.input: Consecutive noncapturing literal or dynamic resource setter operations emitted for the same StyleBase. Each run has at least three operations. Names are alpha-renamed only for the receiver. Value constructors taking the XAML context are evaluated at their original position. Other operations terminate a run.

encodings.direct: One native function per run with original setter calls, original typed property getters and value constructors.
encodings.program: Each run owns 2-byte instructions and three independent slices of typed property getters, lazy value constructors and dynamic keys.
encodings.slots: Each distinct (operation, getter, operand expression) has a shared Rust function. Each run retains the ordered slice of only the functions it uses.

setter_program_experiment.checks: The extractor decodes every 2-byte instruction using that run’s three import tables, and expands every function-slot sequence, then checks that all 1,177 operations match the original getter, operand and order.
setter_program_experiment.limits: The fixture compiles callable code against actual optimized framework rlibs. DSO sizes include code/data, unwind, exports, dynamic imports and relocations. It isolates this compiler design and does not measure a complete release executable, host activation, failures, or runtime performance. None of these prototype setters ships in the PR.

xamlx_group_lookup_fixture.description: Separate executable constructs XamlTypeWellKnownTypes 60 times per process against the actual XamlX FakeTypeSystem. Compare the same full fields, generic Action/Func arities, public constructor and LLVM/LTO settings. This measures named lookup only; static and dynamic theme setter probes are independent.
xamlx_group_lookup_fixture.build: XamlX rlib with testing feature, opt-level=z, 8 CGUs and embedded bitcode. Fixture Cargo-equivalent final -Oz, FatLTO, one CGU, LLD safe ICF, RELR, unwinding and symbol stripping. No PGO on the fixture.
xamlx_group_lookup_fixture.metric: Within-process elapsed wall nanoseconds per construction. Alternating order on CPU 6; three warmup pairs omitted. Median paired ratio, interval from 3,000 paired bootstrap resamples, seed 486.
xamlx_group_lookup_fixture.extra_coverage: Verified first-error cutoff, retained-reference counts after lookup errors and panics, an empty group, ordered fields, and repeated handles.

candidate_architecture.compiler_input: Lower after XamlX type, overload, static-resource and name-scope resolution, before emitting native Rust. Resource roots and their typed imports stay independent. Generate whole resource-dependency groups together only when the compiler can prove their reachability is identical.
candidate_architecture.program_storage: Share an import dictionary for the complete enclosing deferred factory. Refer to typed constructors, setters, child factory entry points and dynamic keys by local bounded operand indices. Keep names, namespace scope and delta-encoded source position in the executable program. Distinct imports are typed Rust function pointers, evaluated lazily in the original order.
candidate_architecture.execution: Keep measured hot templates on the direct Rust path while comparing a pre-resolved program for cold templates. A frame must hold the original concrete boxed/reference form of each local and destroy completed locals in reverse construction order on ordinary completion, XAML errors and panic. Preserve first-use property registration, BeginInit/EndInit/parent-stack ordering, source diagnostic locations, and the generation captured by every deferred factory.
candidate_architecture.external_edits: The existing v1/v2/v3 external FXP front end and arbitrary changed-tree XamlX resolver remain reachable. Compile changed trees to the same operation semantics only after differential tests cover overloads, namespaces, captured parents, typed binding order and failure points. An edit replacing a constructor or child type must use the new operation graph.
candidate_architecture.release_gate: Measure the complete stripped executable after GC and ICF. Include .data.rel.ro, .rodata, relocations, .gcc_except_table and unwind indexes. Run held-out templates, peak RSS, rendered first frame, embedded/edited startup and failed construction paths. Exclude the isolated DSO savings from a production size budget.

reproduction.requirements: Python 3.11+, GNU readelf/nm, x86-64 GNU/Linux, rustc and LLD. Match the production rustc, features and target rlibs. Supply stripped and symbolized links at identical allocated addresses. Rust struct layout can change with toolchain or features.
reproduction.extract_files:
from pathlib import Path
import json
src=json.loads(Path("docs/benchmarks/compiled-theme-metadata-and-replay-linux-x86_64.json").read_text())
for name, code in src["reproduction"]["files"].items(): Path(name).write_text(code)
steps: Build the PGO executable using profile_winui.py per docs/compiled-theme-performance.md and keep its generated compiled_xaml.rs, target dependency search paths and exact target rlib for each of ferroui_base, ferroui_controls, ferroui_markup_xaml and ferroui_themes_winui. Use the matched unstripped link procedure in scripts/themes/bench/attribute_codegen.py.
Run nm -n -S -C --defined-only <unstripped-ELF> | gzip > symbols.nm.gz. Check .text, .rodata, .data.rel.ro and relative relocations have the same addresses and bytes in both links.

Invoke rustc --edition=2021 -Copt-level=z layout.rs --extern ferroui_base=<actual-base-rlib> -L dependency=<target-deps> -L dependency=<host-deps> -o layout; run ./layout > layout.txt. Run python3 catalog.py symbols.nm.gz <stripped-ELF> census.json layout.txt and python3 classify.py <compiled_xaml.rs> symbols.nm.gz > factories.json.

Run python3 emit.py <compiled_xaml.rs> work. The same extracted operations, grouped only within one receiver, are written as direct.rs, program.rs and slots.rs. Compare corpus hashes if running on the measured revision.

For each variant use rustc --crate-name style_row_probe --edition=2021 --crate-type=lib --emit=obj -Copt-level=z -Ccodegen-units=1 -Cpanic=unwind -Cllvm-args=--addrsig <variant>.rs -o <variant>.o with the four --extern entries and two -L dependency paths above. The fixture compilation used the optimized target rlibs without enabling profile-use on the fixture itself.

Link each using ld.lld -shared --gc-sections --icf=safe -z pack-relative-relocs --strip-all -soname rows <variant>.o -o <variant>.so. Run readelf -SW and stat on both objects and DSOs. The DSOs intentionally leave framework imports external. File paths, symbol names and tool versions can change absolute bytes.

files.classify.py:
"""Attribute emitted WinUI code to the compiled XAML document/factory bodies."""
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter,defaultdict
import gzip,re,subprocess,json,sys
src=Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text()
p=Path(sys.argv[2])
lines=gzip.open(p,'rt') if p.suffix=='.gz' else p.open()
args=[str(p)]
fpat=re.compile(r'^(?:pub(?:\(crate\))? )?fn (\w+)\(',re.M)
fun={}; roots=Counter(); data=defaultdict(list); ops=Counter()
for m in fpat.finditer(src):
 stop=src.find('\n}',m.end()); f=src[m.start():stop]; name=m[1]
 key='others'
 if name.startswith('populate_') and '_part_' in name:key='merged dictionary installation'
 elif 'selector_shape' in name:key='selector builder'
 elif 'template_setter' in name:key='closed template property thunk'
 elif 'style_property' in name:key='style property import'
 elif 'rt::deferred_context' in f:
  if 'ControlTheme::new()' in f:key='style/theme factory'
  elif '.begin_init();' in f:key='visual tree factory'
  else:key='other deferred body'
 elif 'factory_shape_' in f and 'fn __' not in f:key='shape operand thunk'
 elif name=='build_controls_winuicontrols_xaml':key='root theme catalog installation'
 fun[name]=(key,f)
seen=set(); syms=[]
for line in lines:
 t=line.strip().split(None,3)
 if len(t)!=4 or t[2].lower()!='t':continue
 name=t[3];prefix='ferroui_themes_winui::compiled_xaml::'
 if not name.startswith(prefix):continue
 name=name[len(prefix):];adr=int(t[0],16);sz=int(t[1],16)
 if adr in seen:continue
 seen.add(adr);k,code=fun.get(name,('unmapped native name',''))
 data[k].append((name,sz));syms.append((adr,sz,k,name))
for line in src.splitlines():
 if not line.startswith('    ') or line.strip().startswith('//'):continue
 for m in re.finditer(r'rt::(\w+(?:::\w+)*)\(',line):ops[m[1]]+=1
report={'input':str(args or 'non-PGO compact Fat'), 'emitted_functions':len(fun), 'groups':{k:{'physical_bodies':len(v),'text':sum(s for n,s in v),'largest':sorted(v,key=lambda t:-t[1])[:3]} for k,v in sorted(data.items(),key=lambda t:-sum(s for _,s in t[1]))},'operations':dict(ops.most_common(85))}
print(json.dumps(report,indent=2))

xamlx_method_predicate_fixture.description: Second isolated two-class fixture with 12 methods per class. Each iteration performs a single-result predicate scan alternating an early hit and a miss, then an all-results static-method scan over both classes. Both implementations verify identical counts and ordering follows the existing traversal. Two predicates represent the small-fixture case; production uses additional predicates.
xamlx_method_predicate_fixture.time_metric: Elapsed wall nanoseconds per iteration; same pinned interleaving and bootstrap as the group lookup fixture.
